excerpts.author: 0xalizk
excerpts.content:
> is there a reason why attestation/IL broadcast is out of reach?

I don't know tbh, we would have to integrate tor/mixnet into a CL and see. But would be a worthy endeavour I agree. 
For the immediate term we are focused on `eth_sendRawTransaction` through Tor for both local nodes and wallets.
